text: 11月6日，“购在中国·2026精品消费月”启动仪式在上海举行。商务部副部长鄢东出席并致辞。上海市副市长王华杰、北京市副市长唐文弘、重庆市副市长黄茂军、广州市常务副市长边立明出席并介绍本市重点活动及举措。商务部认真贯彻落实党中央、国务院关于扩内需促消费决策部署，坚持惠民生和促消费紧密结合，组织开展“购在中国·2026精品消费月”活动，聚焦精品主题、突出国际特色，发挥国际消费中心城市示范引领作用，打造“购在中国”年度重头戏，持续释放消费潜力。
text_en: On November 6, the launch ceremony of the "Shopping in China · 2026 Quality Consumption Month" was held in Shanghai. Vice Minister of Commerce Yan Dong attended and delivered remarks. Shanghai Vice Mayor Wang Huajie, Beijing Vice Mayor Tang Wenhong, Chongqing Vice Mayor Huang Maojun, and Guangzhou Executive Vice Mayor Bian Liming attended and introduced their cities' key activities and measures. The Ministry of Commerce earnestly implements the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council on expanding domestic demand and boosting consumption, closely combines improving people's livelihoods with promoting consumption, and organizes the "Shopping in China · 2026 Quality Consumption Month" campaign. Focusing on quality themes and highlighting international features, it leverages the demonstration and leading role of international consumption center cities to create the flagship annual event of "Shopping in China" and continuously unlock consumption potential.
